body.x: ecarPlug will exhibit electric car chargersat CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA fromJanuary 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019.

ecarPlug Electric car charger is a newconcept electric car charger that is controlled by smart phone. It is aconvenient electric car charger that replaces the user interface of theexisting electric car charger with a smart phone that is easy to use for userauthentication, operation of charger, payment, confirmation of charginghistory, etc. by user's smartphone.

The feature of an electric car charger is thatit can be charged to three cars at the same time, which can lower theinstallation cost of the charger. In addition, mobile payment through usersmartphone is possible. In addition, you can choose from three charging modes:automatic charging mode, smartphone controlled charging mode, and RFID chargingmode.

On the other hand, Seongnam IndustryPromotion Agency participating in CES 2019 is an organization that is in chargeof providing financial support for SMEs and venture companies in Seongnam. It helpscompanies with global investors and buyer networking and promotions. It alsoactively supports the participation in CES 2019 as a part of the global exportbusiness development program.
